mapper_cycles_caveat: Mapper graph cycles are not automatically topological loops (baseline E2 no-loop control); structural statistics are reported beside every graph.

pca.note: PCA on the z-scored primary cloud; deterministic (SVD).

mapper_S_caveat: S is the baseline's exploratory membership-overlap indicator (mean best-match Jaccard); it is NOT a canonical graph distance and is never used alone to rank parameter choices.

mapper_day_of_year.note: Day-of-year lens encodes calendar information directly into the filter function; any apparent seasonal separation under this lens is partially built in and must be read beside the unsupervised PCA-lens result.

structure.cycles_caveat: Mapper graph cycles are not automatically equivalent to true topological loops in the data: the no-loop control produces short noise-scale graph cycles while its H1 diagram correctly shows no dominant class. Cycle length and scale context distinguish loop-like structure from noise.

state_space_ph.gap_ratio_convention: r_k = p_k / p_{k+1} with persistences sorted in descending order. The rank k is known from the synthetic construction of each dataset (annulus k=1, figure-eight k=2, controls: none); r_k is NOT a universal automatic loop-counting rule, and the 'prominent' threshold (r_k >= 3) is a stated convention, not a theorem.
state_space_ph.note: Vietoris-Rips PH of the 3-D z-scored state-space cloud itself — distinct from the temporal sliding-window embedding; a loop here would be a loop in daily weather states, not in time.

seasonal_ph.convention: Sliding-window (time-delay) embedding: point i is the vector (x[i], x[i+tau], ..., x[i+(d-1)*tau]) of the z-scored daily series; span = (d-1)*tau days; stride = days between consecutive window starts. The annual cycle period is T = 365.25 days; spans near one period are expected to resolve the seasonal loop if one is present.
seasonal_ph.prominence_convention: dominant H1 persistence and r_1 = p1/p2 (baseline GAP_RATIO_CONVENTION); r_1 >= 3 is a stated convention, not a theorem
seasonal_ph.interpretation_guard: A dominant H1 class in a sliding-window embedding evidences a recurrent quasi-periodic structure of the embedded series at the studied scale; it is NOT proof that the underlying climate process follows a simple closed physical trajectory.
